$comment: Shell-owned action an MFE executes against the screen domain to show a toast: the shell owns the only toaster (sonner, main.tsx). The MFE sends the text already in the user's language — the dictionary is the MFE's, not the shell's. See notifyAction.ts.

kind.$comment: STUDIO_NOTICE_KINDS in mfe-shared (host/hostActions.ts); picks the toast's icon and colour. A loading toast stays until a notice with its id replaces it.

id.$comment: A notice with the id of a shown toast replaces it (sonner's toast id). Required for a loading notice: nothing else can end that toast.
